senses.definition: An element of an educational curriculum concerned with bodily development, physical health and wellness, strength, physical co-ordination, and agility.
senses.example: But it can be recalled that Locsin earlier called out DepEd for seemingly being “unaffected” by the actions of a teacher who body-shamed her by describing her “an obese person” in a Physical Education (PE) educational material after the agency issued an apology.
